{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-wy-c","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"99ade1b7c70b0a11b2d3ee961378f90a18131c529cf0199690e43c78f1f8bbf6","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-wy-class-c:lineage:24","source_registry_sha256":"f2806994ac56e29c3588fb4e8e2cc870c5f64d0616933994765d31d7841ccbe9","source_liveness_sha256":"e9e98c5695424e30c400f1e14b2593178d09ca723f8f00581c9655dcae32ca6c"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Instruction permits and graduated licenses","heading":"C2 — Instruction permits and graduated licenses","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Instruction permits and graduated licenses
FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A01
An intermediate license may be issued when the applicant reaches age 16. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A02
Holding a Restricted Class C license is one route to intermediate-license eligibility. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A02
The instruction-permit route to an intermediate license requires 50 hours behind the wheel, including 10 nighttime hours, certified by a parent or legal guardian. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A02
An intermediate-license applicant must present identity evidence and pass vision screening. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A02
An intermediate applicant must pass a driving-skills test unless that test is waived after completion of an approved driver-education course. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A02
The intermediate-license applicant must pay the required fee and obtain a minor's release signed by a parent or legal guardian. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A02
An intermediate-license driver may carry at most one passenger under 18 who is not immediate family unless a licensed driver aged 18 or older is also present. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A02
An intermediate-license holder must make sure every occupant wears a seat belt. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A02
An intermediate-license driver may drive between 11 p.m. and 5 a.m. only when an exception applies and a completed exception form is presented. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A02
A medical necessity certified by medical personnel can qualify an intermediate-license driver for a night-driving exception. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R11 | anchor: A02
An employer-certified trip to or from work can qualify for the intermediate-license night-driving exception. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R12 | anchor: A02
Trips to or from school, school activities, organized youth sports or religious activities can qualify for the night-driving exception when certified by a parent or legal guardian. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R13 | anchor: A02
A medical emergency evidenced by medical personnel can qualify for the intermediate-license night-driving exception. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R14 | anchor: A02
The person appropriate to the claimed exception must complete and sign the intermediate driver's exception form. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R15 | anchor: A02
An intermediate driver using an exception must carry the signed form and show it to law enforcement if stopped. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R16 | anchor: A02
A violation of the intermediate-license provisions causes a 30-day suspension. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0014]
